name: What are the common strategies for buying a new home before selling my current one?

mainEntity.name: What are the common strategies for buying a new home before selling my current one?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are generally three strategies: making a contingent offer, securing a bridge loan, or selling your current home first and renting temporarily. A contingent offer means your new home purchase is dependent on your current home selling, which can make your offer less attractive to sellers in competitive markets. A bridge loan offers short-term financing to cover both mortgages but adds a financial commitment. Selling first and renting can reduce financial pressure and make you a stronger buyer, but requires a temporary move.
